items.title: Product Foundation
items.desc: Set up GitHub, Flutter, Android device runtime, branch workflow and startup structure.

items.title: Interactive MVP dashboard
items.desc: Mobile-first dashboard with routine cards, Accept/Skip/Mute, live discipline score and status badges.

items.title: Persistence, navigation and streak foundation
items.desc: Added bottom navigation, progress screen, goals screen, shared preferences, best score and streak foundation.

items.title: AuraBoard AI Product Ops Dashboard
items.desc: Make AuraBoard part of the codebase with JSON-driven backlog, sprint visibility and founder progress tracking.

items.title: As founder, I can open AuraBoard after git pull
items.desc: AuraBoard should load sprint and backlog items from a repo-managed JSON source instead of only static seed data.

items.title: As founder, I can see sprint progress clearly
items.desc: Show current sprint, total items, done/review count and MVP progress.

items.title: As founder, I can identify next action
items.desc: Board should show whether the next action is AI implementation, user testing, code review or release decision.

items.title: Reminder and Notification Engine
items.desc: Add local notifications, reminder scheduling, snooze and track-only mode.

items.title: AI Plan Builder
items.desc: User explains current life situation and AI creates goals, plan, schedule and reminders.

items.title: Emotional Image Reminder Generator
items.desc: Generate emotional visual reminders, banners and lock-screen style images with user-approved photos and text.
